authority_rule: Roles define responsibility and capability ceilings. Effective authority is always case authority intersected with the role ceiling, runtime availability, exact targets, and denials.

permission_modes.read_draft_only: May read allowlisted public sources and draft a local artifact; cannot mutate governed targets.
permission_modes.local_mutation_exact_targets: May edit only exact locally claimed targets and run declared checks.
permission_modes.review_only_frozen_candidate: May inspect a frozen candidate and issue a verdict; cannot repair or execute it.
permission_modes.verification_only_no_repair: May run deterministic checks and read back exact targets; cannot repair failures.
permission_modes.knowledge_candidate_only: May propose reviewed knowledge with lineage; cannot promote it durably.
permission_modes.browser_local_only: May project and export browser-local packets; cannot become a source of truth.
permission_modes.observation_only: May observe runtime evidence; cannot activate, mutate, or complete runtime work.
permission_modes.external_action_exact_approval: May perform one exact externally approved action with idempotency and readback.
permission_modes.git_action_exact_approval: May perform one exact owner-approved Git action after checks and readback.

tool_capabilities.read_allowlisted_sources: Read only sources admitted by the active case boundary.
tool_capabilities.query_bounded_retrieval: Run allowlisted LlamaIndex retrieval or its lexical fallback.
tool_capabilities.query_structural_index: Query an allowlisted structural index without treating generated relationships as semantic truth.
tool_capabilities.draft_local_artifact: Create a local candidate without external writeback.
tool_capabilities.edit_claimed_targets: Edit only the exact targets claimed by the binding.
tool_capabilities.run_browser_qa: Inspect local browser output and accessibility evidence.
tool_capabilities.write_review_verdict: Write approve, revise, or block against a frozen candidate.
tool_capabilities.propose_knowledge_candidate: Prepare a lineage-bearing memory candidate without promotion authority.
tool_capabilities.write_run_receipt: Record a public-safe execution or handoff receipt.
tool_capabilities.observe_runtime: Observe runtime state without activation or mutation.
tool_capabilities.perform_exact_external_action: Perform one target-specific approved external action.
tool_capabilities.perform_owner_approved_git_action: Perform one exact owner-approved Git action.
tool_capabilities.readback_exact_target: Read the post-action target and compare it with the intended result.

roles.title: Goal and Architecture Operator
roles.goal: Bind the objective, done conditions, state design, and gate contract without expanding authority.
roles.purpose: Convert an ambiguous request into one bounded case and explicit architectural gates.

roles.title: Admission Controller
roles.goal: Classify risk, select the approved profile and minimum roles, and stop work that fails admission.
roles.purpose: Produce a deterministic planning-only admission receipt before role work begins.

roles.title: Source and Context Operator
roles.goal: Build the allowlist, stable CAG context, bounded retrieval plan, and source-visible perception capsule.
roles.purpose: Give each role the smallest sufficient context while retaining project-wide perception through citations and retrieval routes.

roles.title: Requirements and Market Research
roles.goal: Turn reviewed evidence into requirement candidates, market boundaries, disconfirmation, and acceptance checks.
roles.purpose: Separate observed pain and market evidence from hypotheses, demand claims, and owner-approved requirements.

roles.title: Onboarding Guide
roles.goal: Give a contributor role-safe context, explain why the work matters, and propose a validated first action.
roles.purpose: Turn governed knowledge into a comprehensible first contribution without inventing organizational truth or authority.

roles.title: Task and Handoff Planner
roles.goal: Create dependencies, bounded task packets, exact checks, stop rules, and owner questions.
roles.purpose: Translate reviewed requirements into daily work with one output owner and an explicit review route.

roles.title: Positioning and Copy Maker
roles.goal: Create evidence-linked copy, positioning, and claim tables without sending or publishing.
roles.purpose: Translate a reviewed pain-mechanism-outcome chain into channel-appropriate candidate language.

roles.title: Qualification and Channel Planner
roles.goal: Separate company fit, person currentness, stage, channel, and exact-send readiness.
roles.purpose: Qualify outreach with current public evidence before any message candidate reaches an action gate.

roles.title: Designer
roles.goal: Make editable, responsive, accessible visuals or interfaces from approved content and exact target constraints.
roles.purpose: Own visual hierarchy, interface grammar, accessibility evidence, editable sources, and rollback-safe implementation.

roles.title: Implementation Maker
roles.goal: Change only claimed files and produce focused checks, rollback evidence, and assigned repairs.
roles.purpose: Implement a reviewed requirement within an exact local target boundary.

roles.title: Action Validator
roles.goal: Check requirements, permission, side effects, rollback, verification, and readback before execution.
roles.purpose: Issue eligibility, repair, approval-wait, or blocked verdicts without executing the proposal.

roles.title: Verifier
roles.goal: Run deterministic checks and produce reproducible regression and exact-readback evidence.
roles.purpose: Verify the frozen result independently without silently becoming its repair maker.

roles.title: Independent Reviewer
roles.goal: Approve, revise, or block a frozen candidate with calibrated claims and exact repair requests.
roles.purpose: Preserve maker-reviewer separation across architecture, evidence, action, knowledge, and release gates.

roles.title: Knowledge Librarian
roles.goal: Search duplicates and propose lineage, supersession, freshness, and retrieval-safe knowledge promotion.
roles.purpose: Retain future-useful meaning after acceptance while excluding raw traces, secrets, and unsupported claims.

roles.title: Integrator
roles.goal: Register lanes, resolve conflicts, merge approved work in order, and deliver final receipts and handoff.
roles.purpose: Own shared surfaces and final integration without replacing independent review or inferring permission.

roles.title: External Action Operator
roles.goal: Perform one exact approved external action with preflight, idempotency, receipt, and readback.
roles.purpose: Keep sending, publication, deployment, and writeback outside ordinary maker authority.

roles.title: Release Operator
roles.goal: Prepare a release and perform only an exact owner-approved Git action with proof and readback.
roles.purpose: Keep packaging, release readiness, and Git publication evidence distinct from production deployment.

roles.title: Growth and Outcome Analyst
roles.goal: Preserve event denominators and separate observed outcomes from modeled recommendations.
roles.purpose: Turn evidence and receipts into pursue, pivot, or stop recommendations without inflating signals.

roles.title: Observability and Efficiency Observer
roles.goal: Report runtime drift, usage evidence, and reproducibility gaps without activating or mutating the runtime.
roles.purpose: Make configured, tested, observed, and blocked runtime states explicit.

roles.title: Surface Projection Operator
roles.goal: Project truthful read-only state and export browser-local review packets without becoming a source of truth.
roles.purpose: Keep the dashboard useful to individual contributors and teams while provider and writeback remain disabled.

roles.title: Product Packaging Engineer
roles.goal: Prove clean-clone setup, least privilege, upgrade, uninstall, and rollback for a portable package.
roles.purpose: Turn the reviewed public project into adaptable installation evidence without claiming unproved productization.
